frontmatter.p: AN ACT TO AMEND AND EXTEND THE BOVINE DISEASES (LEVIES) ACT, 1979, AND TO AMEND THE PENALTIES RELATING TO OFFENCES UNDER SECTIONS 48 AND 49 OF THE DISEASES OF ANIMALS ACT, 1966. [16th March, 1996]

sect.p: the Act of 1966 means the Diseases of Animals Act, 1966;
the Minister means the Minister for Agriculture, Food and Forestry;
the Principal Act means the Bovine Diseases (Levies) Act, 1979.
